edito.p1: Ceraghit Creation is above all a story of material, gesture and passion.
edito.p2: Earth is a living material. It changes under the hands, resists, surprises, then slowly reveals a form. It is in this dialogue with the material that Sabri Ghit's sculptures are born.
edito.p3: Each piece is shaped with time, patience and the freedom to let a little chance step in. The textures, the irregularities and the traces of the gesture are not erased: they are part of the work and of its story.
edito.p4: Through Ceraghit Creation, Sabri Ghit seeks less to reproduce reality than to give it another presence. Ceramics then becomes a language, a way of expressing an emotion, an idea or simply a sensation.
edito.p5: This site presents a few of these encounters between earth and hand. Unique works, shaped with passion, that invite everyone to look at the material differently.

terms.title: Terms and conditions of sale
terms.intro: The rules that apply to your orders.

sections.title: 1. Purpose
body: These terms and conditions of sale govern every order placed on this site with Ceraghit Creation ("the studio"). Placing an order means you have read and accepted these terms.

sections.title: 2. Ordering
body: You choose your pieces, add them to the cart, enter your details and delivery address, then pay online. The order is confirmed when the payment is validated: the order tracking page then shows "Paid".
Pieces are reserved for 45 minutes from the creation of the order. Without payment within that time, the order is cancelled and the pieces go back on sale.
A unique piece exists in a single copy: it can only be ordered once. Pieces marked "On quote" cannot be bought from the cart: send a request to the studio.

sections.title: 3. Prices
body: Each piece is offered both in Tunisian dinars (TND) and in euros (EUR). You choose the currency before ordering and pay in that currency: no price is automatically converted from one currency to the other.

Displayed prices exclude delivery costs. Delivery costs are calculated at payment, according to the contents of the cart and the destination country. [VAT / applicable taxes: to be specified by the studio.]

sections.title: 4. Payment
body: Payment is made by bank card (Tunisian and international cards) through our payment provider Konnect. The studio never sees or keeps your card details.
If the payment fails or is abandoned, the order is cancelled and the pieces are returned to stock.

sections.title: 5. Handmade pieces
body: All pieces are modelled by hand. Slight variations in shape, colour, glaze and texture are normal: they are part of the work. Photographs are indicative, especially for glazed pieces whose shade changes with the light.

sections.title: 6. Delivery
body: How costs are calculated, the countries served and the lead times are described on the Delivery page. Indicative preparation time before shipping: [to be confirmed by the studio].

sections.title: 7. Damage in transit
body: Pieces are carefully packed. If a piece arrives damaged, tell the studio within [48 hours: to be confirmed] of receipt, with photographs of the piece and the packaging. The studio will then offer a replacement or a refund.

sections.title: 8. Withdrawal and returns
body: Unique pieces and pieces made to order or personalised cannot be taken back or exchanged, except for a proven defect.

For other pieces, a return is possible within [to be confirmed, for example 14 days] of receipt, after the studio's prior agreement, with the piece sent back intact and in its original packaging. Return costs are borne by the buyer. The refund is made in the currency of payment.
These rules apply subject to any mandatory rights you may have under the law of your country of residence.

sections.title: 9. Quote-only pieces and commissions
body: For a quote-only piece or a custom creation, send a request from the "Unique piece" page. The studio replies by email with a quote. Payment terms (deposit, production times) are set out in the quote.

sections.title: 10. Liability
body: The studio cannot be held liable for delays or damage caused by the carrier or by events beyond its control, nor for customs duties and local import taxes, which are borne by the buyer.

sections.title: 11. Governing law
body: These terms are governed by [Tunisian: to be confirmed] law. In the event of a dispute, the parties first seek an amicable solution; failing that, the courts of [city: to be specified] have jurisdiction.

sections.title: 12. Contact
body: For any question about an order, write to the studio or call it using the details at the bottom of every page, quoting the order number (CER-12345).

shipping.title: Delivery
shipping.intro: How delivery is calculated and what it includes.

sections.title: How the price is calculated
body: The delivery price depends on the weight and size of the box, not on the value of the order, unless a free delivery offer applies. For each piece, the studio records its packed weight and the dimensions of its box.

The carrier charges the higher of two weights: the actual weight (pieces plus protective packaging) or the volumetric weight (length × width × height in cm, divided by 5,000). The charged weight is rounded up in steps of 0.5 kg.

The rate of the destination zone (Tunisia, Europe or rest of the world) applies to that weight, plus a fuel surcharge for express shipments and handling fees for the protective packaging of fragile pieces.

sections.title: Amounts
body: Amounts are not fixed: they are calculated at payment, once your country is chosen, and shown before you pay. You can see the delivery zone and the charged weight. [Rate card: to be confirmed by the studio.]
Depending on the destination, delivery may be free above a certain order amount; the threshold, if any, is shown in the cart and at payment.

sections.title: Carriers and lead times
body: Shipments are handed to an express carrier (DHL Express or equivalent) or to a local courier for Tunisia. [Carriers and indicative delivery times by zone: to be confirmed by the studio.]
A tracking number is sent by the studio as soon as the parcel ships, when the carrier provides one.

sections.title: Countries served
body: The list of countries served is offered in the order form. An order that is too heavy or too large for online delivery gets no price: the studio then prepares a transport quote on request.

sections.title: Customs duties and taxes
body: For shipments outside Tunisia, any customs duties, import taxes and clearance fees are borne by the buyer, according to the rules of the destination country. They are not included in the price paid online.

sections.title: Receiving your parcel
body: Check the condition of the parcel on delivery and report any problem to the studio according to the terms and conditions of sale.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: The data we collect and what we do with it.

sections.title: Who is responsible
body: Ceraghit Creation, [company name], is responsible for processing the data collected on this site. Contact: details shown at the bottom of every page.

sections.title: What we collect
body: When you order: name, email, phone, delivery address, country, any note, and the contents and amount of the order.
When you request a unique piece: name, email, phone and country (optional), project description, dimensions, budget and inspiration links.
In your browser: your currency, your language and the contents of your cart, kept locally so the site works. No advertising trackers are used.

sections.title: Why
body: To process and deliver your order, answer your requests, keep the studio's accounts and meet our legal obligations.

sections.title: Who we share it with
body: Konnect (card payment), Vercel (hosting), Neon (database), Cloudflare (images) and the carrier in charge of delivery (name, address, phone). These providers only use it to deliver their service.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: Orders: [duration to be confirmed, for example 10 years for accounting records]. Unique piece requests: [duration to be confirmed, for example 24 months].

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can ask for access to your data, its correction or its deletion, within the limits of our legal retention obligations, by writing to the studio.
